rules_note: A dwelling rented fewer than 15 days in the year is reported from the facts recorded here; personal use over 14 days, or over 10 percent of the days rented, marks a dwelling as a residence for the year; an average stay of at most 7 days, or of at most 30, is the service level the recorded facts carry. The report shows each predicate, the recorded services note, and both allocations of the operating and of the interest-and-taxes cents - by rental days and by the year's length - with nothing booked from them.
